verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of calendar invites that carry the interview kit or scorecard, and none of automated reminders to submit feedback. The only related item is the AI Notetaker, which maps notes to scorecard questions to speed up submission. That is an adjacent feature, not interviewer preparation through invites and reminders, so it earns no credit for this applicable ATS axis.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, interviewers get prepared automatically — calendar invites carry the interview kit, the scorecard, and reminders to submit feedback
